data.name: ClearBackupFolderButton.ToolTip
data.value: Clears the backup path and disables all backup features.

data.name: DefaultBackupFolderButton.ToolTip
data.value:
Sets the backup thumbnail cache folder to the default folder, depending on how the program is installed/located.
If the program is installed in a restricted folder such as in Program Files, the default location will be in AppData.
If the program is ran portably or installed in a non-restricted folder, the default location will be in the same directory as the program.

data.name: AutoBackupAfterPreloadCheckBox.ToolTip
data.value: Toggles whether to backup the thumbnail cache after preloading completion if Auto Backup is enabled.

data.name: ExplorerCacheDeletionMethodLabel.ToolTip
data.value:
Sets the method used to delete the explorer thumbnail cache This affects the deletion and the restoration of thumbs cache
"Manual Deletion" is the default and the fastest method, though it may be less stable in certain situations
"Disk Cleanup" uses Windows' method which is slower, though it may be more stable in certain situations

data.name: ExplorerCloseFrequencyLabel.ToolTip
data.value: Determines how often to close explorer.exe when force copying or deleting thumbnail cache files.

data.name: BackupRestoreClearSafetyLabel.ToolTip
data.value: Determines whether or not backup/restore/clear functions should either partially complete or cancel on any failure.

data.name: AutoBackupIntervalLabel.ToolTip
data.value: Sets the interval that the application checks for when to make an auto backup of the thumbnail cache

data.name: CacheSizeUpdateIntervalLabel.ToolTip
data.value: Sets the interval that the thumbnail cache sizes are updated

data.name: CacheSizeFormatLabel.ToolTip
data.value:
Sets the size format that the cache sizes display
"Auto" switches between size formats depending on the sizes of the backup or explorer thumbs cache

data.name: AutoRestoreIntervalLabel.ToolTip
data.value: Sets the interval that the application checks for when to auto restore the thumbnail cache from the backup
